title: Chapter 301: Undead Counterattack
content:
Chapter 301: Undead Counterattack

Outside the canyon, there was a huge army.

These troops were all human soldiers, and Wang Shuo did not launch an attack immediately.

In front of the army, a general walked out.

This person was wearing a red lining, and the red breastplate protruded outward, outlining her graceful figure.

Her face was as beautiful as lotus, her lips were painted red, and her eyebrows were slanted, but they contained murderous intent.

A big red cloak fluttered in the wind, making her look more heroic.

"I am Bu Lanlan, the mayor of Qinghe Town, and I am here to help on the orders of Lin County Magistrate."

Wang Shuo was a little absent-minded when he looked at the female general in front of him. Suddenly, he heard what the other party said and came back to his senses.

"Thank you, Mayor Bu, for coming to rescue me, but you are late."

Wang Shuo didn't know how to call Bu Lanlan for a while, so he just called her Mayor Bu. It felt strange to call a young woman in her prime the mayor.

Bu Lanlan looked deeply into the canyon and couldn't help but take a breath.

The scene inside was so amazing that even someone like her who was used to seeing life and death couldn't help but marvel at it.

"Mayor Wang, you are really amazing. You deserve to be the number one in our Changping County."

Bu Lanlan's pretty face showed a smile.

"Mayor Bu, you are too flattering!"

Wang Shuo immediately turned his head away, not daring to look directly at the other party. This kind of female general is really charming!

Then, Wang Shuo led his army back to the previous camp.

Bu Lanlan also took 5,000 soldiers from Qinghe Town and stationed nearby.

The number of troops coming to support from the periphery gradually increased.

...

The news of Falati's death soon reached the ears of the bloodthirsty demon wolf, which made him furious.

"Waste."

At the moment, he also understood his situation. The attack on the periphery town was blocked, and many human troops rushed over. He was already surrounded.

But some small towns were still captured, and the number of undead troops was also increasing.

The undead army that had rushed over had not had a large-scale conflict with the scattered human armies on the periphery. Both sides were gathering their troops and waiting for the final decisive battle.

A few days later, both sides felt that the time for the decisive battle was ripe.

The bloodthirsty demon wolf thought about it and did not attack the city directly, but wanted to defeat these reinforcements first.

So the undead army divided into four groups and launched an attack on the troops stationed on the periphery by Wang Shuo and others.

Wang Shuo and others were facing Wagner's troops besieging the east gate of Changping County.

The number of people has exceeded 50,000.

In addition to Bu Lanlan, Wang Shuo's allies also included Su Xiu who had returned, Zheng Zhongji from Xiaochi Town, and others, with a total force of about 30,000.

Although the overall number of people was not superior, the level gap of the undead army was uneven. The number of the most elite Burning Legion was not large, only less than 10,000.

All these undead came from the ancient battlefield, and their levels were at least 50.

As for the rest, they are skeletons transformed through the altar of the dead, ranging from level 20 to level 50.

After discussing with Lin Xiaotian and the mayors who came to support, this battle adopts the wolf pack tactics to disperse the undead army and fight on their own.

If they are defeated, they will retreat immediately. The troops coming this time are mainly cavalry, so retreat should be very easy.

This tactic is also forced to be adopted. After all, all the troops have never fought together, and it will definitely not be smooth to cooperate. Moreover, there is no commander who can easily command tens of thousands of troops. After all, everyone's command value is not enough.

...

On the plains of the previous battle, the undead army lined up neatly.

This time, there was plenty of time for preparation, and Wang Shuo arranged the battlefield in advance.

On the side of the hillside, Wang Shuo used bronze bricks to build fortifications, combined with the cliffs, to build a wall. On the wall, bronze crossbow carts were lined up.
